name: CPI surprise labels, currency-separated returns, and clearer crypto prices
body:
## Highlights

- **CPI surprises stay visible.** `MDAY` includes a CPI day with no year-over-year actual using its core monthly surprise, labels that basis, and counts prints excluded by a filter; `CPI` and `ECST` explain missing yearly figures. (#2729)
- **Portfolio returns by currency.** Period P&L separates price moves from FX for each currency and names holdings left out; `PORT` matches US and Asian holdings over dates both share. (#2724, #2728)
- **Crypto prices in context.** Headers name the exchange and trade time, stablecoin ranges identify isolated extremes, and prices and range endpoints keep consistent precision. (#2721, #2726, #2730)
- **Names find the right listing.** Tracker Fund opens on HKEX rather than a receipt; Hermès finds its Paris line, and Swiss exchange codes no longer resolve to an unrelated company. (#2717, #2729)

## Also in this release

- Pasted symbol lists preserve blank, invalid and duplicate rows in exports; historical price exports include currency and interval. (#2717)
- A failed history request says to retry instead of claiming the listing has no history. (#2729)
- Sign-in, password and other dialogs can be closed by mouse, with protection against stray clicks during sign-in. (#2721, #2726)
- `RIPL` and `INS` explain unsupported instruments together rather than returning a raw error. (#2728)

[Full diff](https://github.com/gloom-sh/gloomberb/compare/v0.20.13...v0.20.14)
